**Resources**
- **CPU:** 10 FEBio runs pinned to 61 cores against the 32-core quota, no core overlap. About 31 cores are in use and 171 s are throttled every 10 s.
- **Memory:** 28.5 GB of the 137.4 GB cgroup is in use by processes. The rest of the 136.5 GB "used" is file cache, which the system can reclaim. No new out-of-memory kills (still 2).
- **Disk:** /raid has 2.3 TB free.
- **GPUs:** GPU 4 is idle and GPU 1 has nothing of ours. GPUs 0, 2 and 3 have our runs. GPUs 5 and 6 are full with another user's jobs.
